test.name: Negative: single-person census search handed back to search-records
test.description: A request to find one person's census record is not a surname survey. The agent should recognize this and hand back to search-records without calling any tool.

negative.explanation: The user is asking to find one person's census record, not to tabulate every household of a surname across a place's censuses. survey-surname handles multi-household surveys; a single-person record lookup belongs to search-records.

input.delegation:
Find Edmund Dixon's 1850 census record.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: This is a NEGATIVE test: the request is for one person's census record, not a surname survey.
The agent should recognize this is a single-person search and decline WITHOUT calling any tool — no place_search, no record_search, no research_log_append, no Write.
The agent should say something like 'That is a search for one person's record — please use search-records' and stop.
A single tool call (even place_search) is a failure.
